failureClassification: The receiver database preserved one delivery and one effect, but seventy-three of one hundred simultaneous TCP connections failed before an application response because the inherited HTTP server listen backlog was too small. C4 and therefore C6 failed; the run is non-qualifying.
onlyPermittedChange: Use an RC36Server subclass with request_queue_size=128 and daemon_threads=true. This changes connection admission capacity only.
